scope: Twenty-one missing IWW detainees from the February 1919 Red Special and Ellis Island register; only documented institutional segment dates, no invented initial arrests or release outcomes.

june-register.label: One Big Union Monthly, June 1920, printed p.39: individually named February 1919 Red Special detainees, February 11 arrival at Ellis Island and individual March-April releases. Original scan visually reviewed.

voice-report.label: The Voice of Labour, March 22, 1919, p.3, New York Stirred Up over Deportation Issue: contemporary account of February 11 arrival, incommunicado detention and subsequent legal proceedings. Original scan visually reviewed.

prisoner.name: John Berg
prisoner.description: John Berg appears in the IWW prisoner register among the people transferred on the Red Special to Ellis Island in February 1919. The group was detained in federal immigration custody during the campaign to deport radical labor organizers.

cases.charges: Administrative immigration detention pending deportation in the IWW crackdown
cases.sentence: Held at Ellis Island after arrival on February 11, 1919 with the Red Special detainees. The recorded start is the documented Ellis Island admission, not the original arrest or the beginning of all US custody. Earlier detention and travel under guard are not included in the dated interval. Administrative detention pending deportation; no individual criminal conviction or fixed prison sentence established by these sources. The individual release register dates release from Ellis Island March 17, 1919. This documents release from detention, not deportation or a criminal acquittal.

case_research.custody_evidence: Named in the June register of detainees transported to Ellis Island; contemporary March reporting independently confirms prolonged detention and successive efforts to obtain access and habeas corpus relief. The documented February transfer and subsequent institutional custody establish more than an initial arrest.

entries.custody_evidence: Named in the June register of detainees transported to Ellis Island; contemporary March reporting independently confirms prolonged detention and successive efforts to obtain access and habeas corpus relief. The documented February transfer and subsequent institutional custody establish more than an initial arrest.
entries.status_research: Historical custody verified. Existing profiles, cases and photos are preserved. No unsupported vital dates, coordinates, current incarceration, institutional relation or personal support website inferred. The June roster explicitly dates the transfer in 1919; March-April releases belong to that episode, not the June 1920 publication year. No exact original arrest date, full time served, statutory charge, deportation outcome, birth/death date or photograph inferred. Source spelling retained; unverified spelling variants are research leads, not separate identities. February 11 is the start of the documented Ellis Island segment only. Existing John Bergen is a different conscientious objector documented as dying in 1918; he cannot be this 1919 Ellis Island detainee.

cases.charges: Administrative immigration detention pending deportation in the IWW crackdown
cases.sentence: Held at Ellis Island after arrival on February 11, 1919 with the Red Special detainees. The recorded start is the documented Ellis Island admission, not the original arrest or the beginning of all US custody. Earlier detention and travel under guard are not included in the dated interval. Administrative detention pending deportation; no individual criminal conviction or fixed prison sentence established by these sources. The individual release or deportation outcome and full custody duration remain unverified.

case_research.custody_evidence: Named in the June register of detainees transported to Ellis Island; contemporary March reporting independently confirms prolonged detention and successive efforts to obtain access and habeas corpus relief. The documented February transfer and subsequent institutional custody establish more than an initial arrest.

entries.status_research: Historical custody verified. Existing profiles, cases and photos are preserved. No unsupported vital dates, coordinates, current incarceration, institutional relation or personal support website inferred. The June roster explicitly dates the transfer in 1919; March-April releases belong to that episode, not the June 1920 publication year. No exact original arrest date, full time served, statutory charge, deportation outcome, birth/death date or photograph inferred. Source spelling retained; unverified spelling variants are research leads, not separate identities. February 11 is the start of the documented Ellis Island segment only.
